facts.text: Clear the evil out of the Barrow Mound for the Free Goblin Society.
facts.ended_how: replaced: Wayman changed the deal, and the goblins agreed to wall off the stairs and settle only the upper mound (beat_8, beat_10)

facts.text: A huge undead with a greatsword in the Barrow Mound stands in the way (see thread_4).
facts.ended_how: no longer relevant: the clearing goal was dropped, and the goblins are walling off the stairs instead (beat_10)

facts.text: Wayman Tisdale promised Snurk the Walkout never to tell King Hogboon where the Free Goblin Society goblins are, now that they are settling in the upper Barrow Mound.
